review.summary: The fix commit resolves all three round-1 findings. The runbook now makes /opt/apps deploy-owned without changing its contents, consistent with the existing check-host writability requirement. audit-host flags a non-deploy owner and distinguishes existing Schatten paths that need review. The reboot step holds the maintenance lock across the reboot command, and the ADR-005 wording and diagram title were corrected with a regenerated SVG. The changes were exercised in a disposable Ubuntu 26.04 container and shellcheck passed. One minor QA-record omission remains.

findings.summary: The QA record's list of F-only verification omits the new /opt/apps ownership change.
findings.rationale: Runbook section 2.2 now adds an authorized host change that sets /opt/apps ownership, and the QA follow-up paragraph records only its disposable-container test. The Not Verified Here (F) list still names only the backup-directory ownership change, so the F checklist derived from it would miss verifying the real-host /opt/apps ownership.
findings.recommendation: Add the /opt/apps ownership change alongside the backup-directory ownership change in the Not Verified Here (F) list.

prior_finding_dispositions.rationale: Runbook section 2.2 adds a non-recursive ownership step for /opt/apps and a stop-and-review rule for existing Schatten paths, the expected-attention table and deployment storage table include it, and audit-host now reports attention for a non-deploy owner. A disposable Ubuntu 26.04 test confirmed that unrelated contents were unchanged and that the Schatten paths could be created afterwards.

Runbook section 10.2 now runs the reboot inside a non-blocking exclusive maintenance-lock acquisition and refuses when the lock is busy. The disposable test ran the command when idle and refused it while a shared holder existed. The stray paragraph formatting was corrected.
The ADR-005 clause separator is restored, the topology diagram title now marks only the F rollout as pending, and the generated SVG was re-rendered from the source.
